help.zh-CN: 复杂项目（如 eVTOL）：默认 3 轮。

help.en: 1 to 5. Usually 2; 3 for a complex project.
help.zh-CN: 1 至 5 轮。通常 2 轮；复杂项目 3 轮。

help.en: % on top of the subtotal, per currency.
help.zh-CN: 按货币在小计上加的百分比。

help.en: Motors built in this iteration (2 for a back-to-back dyno).
help.zh-CN: 本轮制造的电机数（背靠背测功机为 2 台）。

help.en: None = no testing in this iteration.
Tooling (or modifications) of this iteration: one amount.
help.zh-CN: 本轮的工装（或修改）：一个金额。

help.en: Cost of one motor; multiplied by the motors of the iteration.
help.zh-CN: 单台电机成本；乘以本轮电机数。

help.en: One amount for the bench work of this iteration.
help.zh-CN: 本轮台架测试的总金额。

help.en: One amount for the shipments of this iteration.
Weeks per stage (tooling lead time, manufacturing, testing, shipping transit), in sequence; the project is the sum of the iterations.
help.zh-CN: 每个阶段的周数（工装交期、制造、测试、运输），按顺序相加；项目工期为各轮之和。

help.en: Where the motors leave from; matched to the DHL quotes.
help.zh-CN: 电机发货地；用于匹配 DHL 报价。

help.en: Destination country (ISO code, e.g. AR) and city.
help.zh-CN: 目的地国家（ISO 代码，如 AR）和城市。

help.en: % added to the DHL quote scaled to the weight.
help.zh-CN: 在按重量换算的 DHL 报价上加的百分比。

help.en: The DHL amount is rounded up to a multiple of this, in EUR (0 = no rounding).
help.zh-CN: DHL 金额向上取整到该欧元数的整数倍（0 = 不取整）。

excluded.en: Duties and import VAT are not included.
excluded.zh-CN: 不含关税和进口增值税。

dhl_lanes.note: 2 x 75 kg crates 60x60x40 cm; excl. VAT
